long_biography.plain_text:
A fundraising letter from a fellow Merchant Marine Academy alumnus redirected Bartoszek's career. He called to offer a modest rugby donation, secured an interview at Texaco the next day and moved from shipyard engineering into oil trading. The connection began two decades in commodity markets and later shaped his belief in supporting future midshipmen.

His relationship with baseball stretched beyond the college team he captained. Bartoszek became the New York Yankees' youngest limited partner in 2011 and retained an interest in Yankees Global Enterprises and the YES Network. In Montana, he later helped establish the Big Sky Royals youth programme, coupling professional-sports ownership with the community coaching he practised himself.
